nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs on every pull request to develop/release/master, executing parallel frontend (TypeScript typecheck, ESLint, Vitest) and Rust (cargo check, clippy, test) jobs on macOS runners.
nodes.languageNotes: Toolchain versions (Node 20, pnpm 9, Rust stable, swatinem/rust-cache) are deliberately mirrored from release.yaml so CI validates the same environment used for production builds. Clippy is currently advisory-only (no -D warnings) pending a baseline cleanup, and cargo test is forced single-threaded to avoid races in tests exercising process-global SQLite state.

nodes.name: release.yaml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions release workflow triggered by version tags (v*) that builds, code-signs, notarizes, and publishes ORGII desktop app installers sequentially for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows x64 (Azure Trusted Signing via OIDC), and Linux x64, generating the Tauri updater manifest (latest.json) and a rolling SemVer-guarded beta channel.
nodes.languageNotes: The three platform jobs are chained with `needs:` into a strict macOS -> Windows -> Linux sequence rather than running in parallel, so each subsequent job can download and extend the same GitHub Release's latest.json updater manifest without a race. Windows beta builds intentionally ship NSIS only (WiX/MSI rejects SemVer prerelease versions).
